title: Proofread preserves ordinary quoted-paragraph boundaries while applying genuine block mechanics
body:
## What to build

Diagnose and conditionally repair #393 C, where final Proofread removed the only visible enclosing marks from an ordinary standalone attributed quotation paragraph. Exact mechanical input/output: .git/kntnt-orchestrate/393/docs/evaluation/editorial-393/gpt-retest-2026-10-01/runs/c09/file-versions/0008-7d809a095ae3.md and 0014-6b5acf2767e6.md. The native mechanical child is rollout-2026-10-01T16-00-22-01a0f7c4-253c-7071-b355-a6e0334da8ca.jsonl, indexed by transport-facts.json. Both preserved sample-01 judges reject the lost boundary.

Classify actual presentation under current shared mechanics and en_US scope before freezing new acceptance. A real set-off block supplies its own boundary and takes no outer marks. A plain paragraph after an attribution is not automatically rendered as a block. Preserve valid ordinary quotation boundaries without a preserve-all-marks rule or an assertion that only literal Markdown > can form a block.

Measurement is prospective and conditional: use the independently accepted #499 method, fresh supported native baseline, actual pinned model/effort/CLI and loaded revision, genuine child lineage and complete trace/inventories. Freeze validation material first; independent complete-text/current-contract validation precedes conformance expectations and the committed execution plan. A split in new conformance stops that fixture. Keep semantic judges on neutral paths blind to issue, arm, model, candidate and trace. Historical artifacts/readings remain unchanged. Native editorial minutes are an explicit diagnosing-bugs fast-loop exception; deterministic byte/inventory checks prove only their actual boundary. No product semantics change before an executed own-target red-capable loop and measured cause. Use one causal candidate and the bounded failed-subset revise rule; unresolved actual misses are retained, and non-reproduction ships no speculative wording. Final independent review covers the entire current method and four CONTRIBUTING gates; catalog regeneration follows shipped changes. No integration, issue closure/reconciliation, push, release or global installation is delegated here.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Fresh actual standalone /proofread runs on captured complete plain input, genuine marked block with redundant outer marks, and valid run-in quotation: one file run each; fresh integrated c09-context Redline file run with actual final mechanical stage captured.
- [ ] Plain attributed quotation keeps its visible boundary, true objective block error is corrected, valid run-in quotation is preserved; metadata/meaning/other formatting remain exact and no editorial work is added.
- [ ] Product change follows actual native red and measured setting/locale cause, on Proofread or shared mechanics only where warranted. Shared mechanics/locale changes add meaningful British and Swedish format controls and serialize with Write callers.
- [ ] Redline performs its final mechanical pass once and makes no substantive change afterwards. Report actual stages and complete inventories, not inferred Proofread input.
- [ ] Historical versions/readings remain unchanged, all residual outcomes retained, whole current method independently reviewed, catalog regenerated where due and all four CONTRIBUTING checks pass.

## Blocked by

#499 supplies accepted native stage observation and preparation. Shared mechanics/quotation resources serialize with other editorial owners before candidate edits.
